title: Impactor Vault Bridge - Impact Tresor
description: A simple Fabric mod that bridges Impactor Economy and Vault on Arclight servers.
body:
# Impactor Vault Bridge – Impact Tresor

> One economy. One balance. Full Vault compatibility for Impactor-powered Cobblemon servers.

**Impactor Vault Bridge** is a lightweight Fabric mod that seamlessly bridges **Impactor Economy** and **Vault** for **Arclight** servers, allowing Fabric mods and Paper plugins to share the same economy system without additional setup.

Running a Cobblemon server with **CobbleDollars** and want your existing Paper ecosystem (shops, menus, GUI systems, economy integrations, server stores, and other Vault plugins) to use the same currency? **Impactor Vault Bridge** automatically connects everything together.

Built specifically for **Cobblemon environments**, the bridge ensures a unified economy experience across both the **Fabric modding side** and the **Paper plugin ecosystem**.

Impactor Vault Bridge also includes a flexible configuration system, allowing server owners to customize bridge behavior and various mod settings.

---

## ✨ Features

✔ Automatically registers your **Impactor currency** as a **Vault Economy provider**

✔ Full compatibility with **Vault-enabled Paper plugins**

✔ Shared balances between **Impactor Economy / CobbleDollars** and plugins

✔ Seamless **Fabric ↔ Paper economy integration** on Arclight

✔ Automatic startup registration

✔ Lightweight and optimized implementation

✔ Configuration support for mod behavior customization

✔ Zero configuration required for default operation

✔ Designed specifically for **Cobblemon + CobbleDollars** servers

---

## ⚙ How it works

When the server starts, **Impactor Vault Bridge** automatically exposes your existing **Impactor economy instance** to **Vault**.

The bridge registers itself as a standard Vault economy provider, allowing Paper plugins to interact with the exact same balance system already used by Impactor and CobbleDollars.

This means plugins such as:

- Shop plugins
- GUI menus
- Economy integrations
- Auction systems
- Server stores
- Crates & rewards plugins
- NPC shops
- Other Vault-based plugins

…will automatically use your existing **Impactor / CobbleDollars balance**.

No manual linking, economy synchronization, database migration, or additional setup is required.

---

## 🔧 Configuration

Impactor Vault Bridge includes a built-in configuration system for adjusting bridge behavior and future compatibility settings.

By default, the mod works **out of the box**, but advanced users can customize available options through the generated configuration file.

---

## 📦 Requirements

- Fabric server environment
- Arclight
- Cobblemon
- Impactor Economy
- Vault
- Compatible Paper plugins

---

## 🎯 Use Case

**Before:**

Cobblemon + CobbleDollars → Fabric economy only  
Paper plugins → separate / unusable economy integration

**After installing Impactor Vault Bridge:**

CobbleDollars ⇄ Impactor Economy ⇄ Vault ⇄ Paper Plugins

**One economy. One balance. Everywhere.**
